trials.summary: Trial 01 (sigma_ref 10.25, lr_mu 10.09, lr_gamma 0.52, gamma_anneal 0.10) scored 0.0981 +/- 0.0194, with mu systematically underestimated in every experiment (-34% to -47%).
trials.key_insight: The objective is mu-limited (rel RMSE 39.8% vs gamma 19.5%), and the mu bias is a uniform low shift rather than a few bad experiments.

trials.summary: Trial 02 (sigma_ref 6.84, lr_mu 25.36, lr_gamma 0.44, gamma_anneal 0.20) scored 0.0246 +/- 0.0094, a ~4x gain over trial 01, driven by a much higher mu learning rate that cut the mu rel RMSE from 39.8% to 17.5%.
trials.key_insight: The mu under-shoot was mainly mu under-convergence: raising lr_mu ~2.5x nearly fixed the high-transmission mu bias, leaving the low-signal Trans05 points (-31% mu, -32% gamma at 3nW) as the dominant residual error.
